---
title: "Recruitment to another trial"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

- The export has no recruitment date, so recruitment is not restricted to a follow-up window.
- Added: the difference in proportions (ctDNA − Usual care) from independent Jeffreys Beta(0.5, 0.5) posteriors.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "13-other-trial", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)
```

## Patients recruited by randomized group

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-summary

recruitment_summary <- cohort |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    recruited = sum(other_trial_recruited),
    .by = tx
  ) |>
  mutate(
    proportion = recruited / patients,
    lower_95 = qbeta(0.025, recruited + 0.5, patients - recruited + 0.5),
    upper_95 = qbeta(0.975, recruited + 0.5, patients - recruited + 0.5)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(tx))

write_parquet(
  recruitment_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "recruitment-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

recruitment_summary |>
  mutate(group = group_factor(tx), .before = 1) |>
  select(-tx) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

## Difference in proportions

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-difference

set.seed(config$seeds$supporting + 7000L)

beta_draws <- \(group) {
  counts <- filter(recruitment_summary, tx == group)
  rbeta(
    config$posterior_draws$supporting * 4L,
    counts$recruited + 0.5,
    counts$patients - counts$recruited + 0.5
  )
}

difference_draws <- beta_draws(1L) - beta_draws(0L)

recruitment_difference <- tibble(
  difference_median = median(difference_draws),
  difference_low = quantile(difference_draws, 0.025),
  difference_high = quantile(difference_draws, 0.975),
  prob_higher_ctdna = mean(difference_draws > 0)
)

write_parquet(
  recruitment_difference,
  file.path(results_dir, "recruitment-difference.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

kable(recruitment_difference, digits = 3)
```
